regional_highlights.headline: Coalition energy crisis exposes structural fragility with public ministerial attacks on partners
key_facts: Economics Minister Reiche publicly attacked SPD coalition partners
Chancellor Merz expressed being 'befremdet' by the conflict
Internal CDU calls for Reiche's dismissal
regional_highlights.tension: Razor-thin majority cannot maintain basic unity on core policies

regional_highlights.headline: Trump pressure forces complete UK policy reversal on Chagos Islands handover
key_facts: UK shelves Chagos Islands handover to Mauritius after Trump withdraws support
Trump dismisses UK positions with Chamberlain comparison
Represents direct US intervention in UK policy decisions
regional_highlights.tension: Alliance commitments undermined by unilateral US policy dictation

dynamics_considered_and_rejected.candidate_dynamic: Regional coalition crisis pattern across Germany, Spain, Norway
dynamics_considered_and_rejected.reason_rejected: While all three countries face domestic political pressure, the mechanisms are entirely different - Germany has coalition energy disagreements, Spain faces corruption trials, Norway has parliamentary fuel tax defeats. These represent different types of domestic stress without shared causal factors or coordination.

gaps.expected_dynamic: Economic policy coordination among EU members facing similar Iran war cost pressures
gaps.observed: Only the UK explicitly addressed Iran war economic costs, while other EU members showed no visible coordination on economic response
gaps.assessment: Despite shared exposure to energy price shocks from Middle East conflict, European countries are not coordinating economic responses, suggesting either different impact levels or preference for national over collective solutions
